summary: Frontend retest of the new Timer UI. Streak card + history card + ScrollView are now correctly present and render as expected (initial empty state passes 3/3). ScrollView wraps the body (scrollHeight 804 > clientHeight 698). HOWEVER a new HIGH-priority regression was found: after a session auto-completes, the streak card and history card DO NOT REFRESH. Backend correctly stores the session (session_id fs_255ec16a5d00, xp=2) and increments focus_lock_streak from 0 to 1 (verified via mongosh), and the XP banner (+2 XP) does show — but the UI still displays 🔥 0 / '0 sessions in a row' / empty state 'No focus sessions yet today'. Root cause: `handleComplete()` in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/timer.tsx (lines 98-111) never calls `loadToday()` after the POST /api/focus-sessions succeeds. Compare with `stop()` (line 157) and `killTree()` (line 74) which both call `loadToday()`. Stop-flow and preset/custom input still work correctly. No changes were made to timer.tsx per E1 instructions.

ui_bugs.issue: After a normal (timer-hits-00:00) session completion, the Focus Lock streak card and Today's sessions card do not update. Backend persists the session and increments focus_lock_streak correctly (verified in DB), and +2 XP banner appears, but focus-streak-card still shows 🔥 0 and focus-history-card still shows the 'No focus sessions yet today' empty state until the screen is reloaded. Fix: add `loadToday();` immediately after `setLastXp(res.xp_earned);` in handleComplete (timer.tsx:106). The same pattern is already present in stop() (line 157) and killTree() (line 74).

rca_of_issue: handleComplete (timer.tsx:98-111) is the only session-lifecycle handler that does NOT call loadToday() after mutating server state. When the 1-minute custom timer finishes, the interval fires handleComplete(minutes) which POSTs /api/focus-sessions and stores xp_earned in local state (setLastXp), but never refreshes the `today` state that feeds the streak & history cards. Because loadToday only runs on mount, in stop(), and in killTree(), the natural completion path leaves the UI stale. Reproduction is deterministic: start any preset or custom session, let it run to 00:00, observe that +XP banner appears but streak stays at 🔥 0 and history stays empty. Mitigation: single-line fix — insert `loadToday();` in handleComplete right after setLastXp.
